candidates.source_name: Ephrem the Syrian / Commentary on Numbers
candidates.source_attribution: Ephrem the Syrian, Commentary on Numbers, on 27:12-23. NPNF Series 2, vol. 13. PD. Cf. 1 Tim 4:14, 2 Tim 1:6.
candidates.draft_body:
Ephrem the Syrian Commentary on Numbers (c. 365 AD)

On the Lord's selection of Joshua as Moses' successor — 'Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him' (Num 27:18) — Ephrem reads the laying-on-of-hands as the canonical Old-Testament antecedent of apostolic succession: the spirit-bearing successor is consecrated by the laying-on of the predecessor's hands, ratified by the assembly. The transmission is bodily and visible, not merely charismatic. Tewahedo episcopal-consecration cites Num 27:18 + 1 Tim 4:14 as the canonical doubled-witness for the unbroken chain of laying-on-of-hands that grounds the Patriarchate of Ethiopia in apostolic-Mosaic continuity.

Verify the summary still reflects the source's argument before promoting; substitute a verbatim quote from the NPNF / Charles dump where available, and where applicable cross-check the Andəmta homiletic tradition for resonance.
